name: google_drive_search
title: Search my Google Drive
description:
Full-text search of the signed-in user's Google Drive, including shared drives they can see, through their connected Google account (Drive API v3 files.list, read-only scope; trashed files excluded; newest modified first).
Returns: query, count, files (id, name, mime_type, modified, url, owners) and next_page_token.
Inputs (* required): query* (1-300 characters, matched against file names and contents); mime_type (only this MIME type, e.g. application/vnd.google-apps.document or application/pdf); limit (1-100; default 10).
For SAJHA's own documentation use sajha_search_docs. Runs only for a signed-in SAJHA user; when the account is not linked, or lacks the scope, the call returns a request to connect it with a link instead of a result.
Example: {"query": "quarterly budget", "mime_type": "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet", "limit": 5}

query.description: Words to find in file names and contents

mime_type.description: Only this MIME type, e.g. application/vnd.google-apps.document

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Acts as the caller: needs a linked Google account with Drive read access.
